figure_of_merit.name: expected_fidelity
figure_of_merit.description: Product of the fidelities associated with the operations in the compiled circuit according to the selected Qiskit Target.
figure_of_merit.interpretation: Higher is better; this is an estimate, not an execution on quantum hardware.

quantinuum_h2_56.notes: This is the Qiskit Target used by MQT Predictor. Error and duration values are model metadata, not measurements collected during this run.
